preconditions: Paused, complete supported transient with fresh physical state; network analysis also needs a fresh network state
No active input_work or step_work, including canceling; duration is positive, <=1 s, and <= the rounded product of 1000 and step
Duration advances floating-point time; networks containing capacitors require at least 1e-10 s
effects: Capture graph/settings/current charge/time and queued input into isolated work; apply queued input before advancing
Publish the complete requested advance atomically on success; progress reports attempted output samples without exposing partial physics
Failure/cancel/supersession preserves committed physical state and pending input; one latest step_work is retained; it is not a kept recording or saved project data

Malformed duration/JSON, known-stale guards and existing retry keys do not wait behind initialization. Common guards are checked again after waiting; no step/key is admitted or reserved during that wait

errors.when: Malformed or missing input, invalid values or relationships
Not paused, incomplete/DC/unsupported, stale or network state not ready
Active input or manual step, including canceling
Network capacitor step below 1e-10 s, solver failure or cooperative worker deadline
Per-output-sample mixed integration attempts exceed the unchanged kernel budget
Per-output-sample mixed integration wall time exceeds the unchanged kernel budget
Explicit/Pause cancellation; waiting caller disconnect stops only the wait after admission
A newer source/input/run/document operation makes the captured work obsolete
Original job expired before its waiting response could be joined

completion.mode: compatibility waiting alias: equivalent numeric/unit-text durations can wait for pending initialization before admission, then wait for the same job's final response; retry observes original result

x-normalized-si-relations.operator: duration_s>=minimum for network analyses with capacitors

detailed_schema.x-rounding-policy: Duration compares against rounded(1000*step_s); next larger representable duration refuses. The ceil-derived total-sample estimate is capped at 1000 at that boundary.

checks: Numeric/us/ns equivalents replay the original result
Replay precedes newer context guards and preserves an unrelated saved document
limits: Held-initializer wait, cancellation and post-wait guard behavior are covered by controlled core tests, not an artificial public delay API
This workflow does not establish complete mounted physical input, accessibility or visible-latency acceptance
